description: List every document in one SEC filing by accession number (the primary document, each exhibit, XML and XBRL files, graphics) with seq, type (e.g. "8-K", "EX-99.1"), description, size in bytes, `stored` and `secUrl`. Also returns the filing's cik, companyName, formType, filingDate, acceptedAt, bodyStored, primaryDocument, indexUrl, and `filingId`. A document with an `exhibitId` has readable stored text under that exhibit id; `filingId` identifies the whole submission text. `exhibitId: null` means the document has no readable text row here (XML/XBRL/graphics, or text not held); its `secUrl` still opens it. When `readableIdsResolved` is false the id lookup failed and exhibitId is omitted (unknown, not "none"). `stored: false` means Signal8 holds the filing record but not that document's body; it exists on EDGAR at `secUrl`. A filing not held in the archive returns a not-found error; its documents are still on EDGAR. Coverage: Signal8's SEC EDGAR archive, updated through the day, in its held range (see `archiveFrom` in each response; currently from late 2021, expanding back to 2016 as the history backfill fills in). Before archiveFrom it holds only a scatter, so absence before archiveFrom is not evidence a filing was never filed; SEC EDGAR itself covers earlier periods. Record-only rows (bodyStored: false) have no stored body; the document is at its sec.gov URL.

accessionNumber.description: SEC accession number, dashed ("0001193125-22-010026") or 18-digit compact form
